dc-10: FedEx retired its MD-10 freighters in 2022–23; the remaining registrations are stored airframes, not flying aircraft
temco-d16: Twin Navion conversions — a handful of modified Navions, not a distinct production type
b-17: About 6 airworthy worldwide (Wikipedia list of surviving B-17s); registrations include static airframes
lockheed-12: Fewer than 20 airworthy worldwide, several of them in Europe — likely 8 or fewer flying in the US
christen-eagle: Kit-built (amateur-built) type — outside the certificated scope; FAA code 221020X is actually the Christen/Aviat A-1 Husky
stearman-c3: About 11 survive worldwide and only a few are airworthy
